candidate.description: CArrEntry.size controls a loop that dereferences CArrEntry.head without checking negative/positive bounds or null head.

limitations: The harness copies the conversion function and uses local type stubs.
Windows access violation is not a platform vulnerability confirmation.
FFI caller reachability and process privilege boundary remain unverified.
next_gate: Build or obtain a complete OpenHarmony FFI library and run the malformed input cases in an isolated process.

validation_evidence.asan: WSL Clang 21.1.8; zero-page SEGV for null head in both conversion paths; controls normal
